notes.title: New Trailer Reveal Incoming!
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to share with you the [b]recently revealed trailer for Dark Atlas: Infernum[/b], unveiled during the [b]Horror Game Awards[/b] on [b]Saturday, May 31st[/b]!

[previewyoutube=T5h3JKGDA2Q;full][/previewyoutube]

Dark Atlas: Infernum is a first-person horror experience where psychological survival meets esoteric apocalypse to create an unsettling atmosphere. You play as [b]Natalia Asensio[/b], Grand Master of an outlawed secret order. A prisoner in a collapsing world haunted by ghosts and fractured dimensions.

Guided by a voice inside your head, you must navigate between physical and mental realms, face your inner demons, and try to stop the end of the world. Set in the expansive [b]Radiata Saga[/b] universe, the game blends a strong narrative with immersive terror and meticulously crafted audiovisual design.

[b]And yes—there’s already a demo available on Steam.[/b]
If you haven’t played it yet… now is the perfect time to step into the darkness.

Stay tuned, watch the reveal, and remember:
[b]If hell is a state of the soul, these are the steps that lead you to its gates.[/b]

notes.title: Dark Atlas: Infernum Unveils New Demo and Key Art at Scream Fest 3
notes.notes:
This Halloween, fans of psychological horror are in for a treat as [b]Dark Atlas: Infernum[/b] makes its chilling debut at Scream Fest 3. The event will showcase an [i][b]exclusive demo of the game[/b][/i], available on Steam only during the festival. Players will have a unique opportunity to explore the haunting world of Dark Atlas: Infernum, diving deeper into its dark storyline and intense survival horror experience.

In addition to the demo, we will unveil the [i][b]latest key art[/b][/i], which captures the essence of Dark Atlas: Infernum's dark and haunting world. The new artwork offers a visual centerpiece of the game’s terrifying atmosphere, emphasizing the psychological horror themes and foreboding environments that will define the experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42784044/c664ccdd308c3efdbd9c3a0a6c267036047e8ec1.jpg[/img]

Alongside the key art, we will also reveal never-before-seen [i][b]screenshots[/b][/i] that showcase some of the game’s most detailed and immersive locations. These images provide a glimpse of the rich textures, chilling lighting, and meticulously crafted settings that players will encounter, building anticipation for the project as it progresses through development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42784044/9486a03627a767a930e5ade1a3e01fa8c41730e8.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Dark Atlas: Infernum to Make Debut at Tokyo Game Show 2023 Steam Digital Event
notes.notes:
Dark Atlas: Infernum, the psychological horror game, is set to make its debut at the Tokyo Game Show 2023 Steam digital event. Gamers and horror enthusiasts around the world can look forward to an exclusive gameplay reveal of this immersive single-player experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42784044/6b13b6c5c155e5936599d9372a18c664c8d3007b.png[/img]

Dark Atlas: Infernum, a first-person survival horror game, is poised to deliver a spine-tingling experience that explores a world filled with mysterious spectral beings known as "imprints." These ghostly humanoid figures materialize in everyday places following violent electrical storms referred to as "umbras." The game's narrative weaves an intricate tale of intrigue, survival, and the battle for control in an apocalyptic world.

In the game, players step into the shoes of Natalia Asensio, a former Grand Master of the Night Council, the oldest occult order in the Western world. As the world falls into chaos and various factions seek to gain control, Natalia must unlock her memories, resist the enigmatic "The Word," and navigate the dark labyrinth of her mind. Her quest is to prevent those who seek to control the world from harnessing the power of the Corona Radiata, a powerful grimoire.

The exclusive gameplay reveal of Dark Atlas: Infernum is eagerly awaited by fans of horror and gaming alike. It promises to be a hauntingly unforgettable experience that will leave players questioning the boundaries of reality and the supernatural.

Stay tuned to the Tokyo Game Show 2023 Steam digital event for a firsthand look at Dark Atlas: Infernum and a glimpse into the chilling world it has in store.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2089630/Dark_Atlas_Infernum/

notes.title: Add now Dark Atlas: Infernum to your Wishlists! (Announcement Trailer)
notes.notes:
Take a trip into the world of the [b]Dark Atlas: Infernum[/b], the first-person horror survival game from developer Night Council Studio. It will be available on [b]Xbox and [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10009333]PlayStation [/url]consoles[/b] as well.

Following a spate of violent electrical storms, ghostly-looking humanoid figures suddenly start to appear in living rooms, on the streets, in parks, shops and in churches. They do not move. They do not speak. They do not react. Scientists are baffled but the true sorcerers of our time have had visions, nightmares, and premonitory dreams where the world falls apart and tyrannies proliferate and sects, secret organisations and demonic cults seek a way to gain control of what remains of humanity.

You are [b]Natalia Asensio[/b], former Grand Master of the oldest occult order in the West: the Night Council. And while everything burns and the sky cracks, you must descend into the abysses of your mind, walk the paths of hell and seek answers to all questions. Unlock your memories, resist the influence of the enigmatic character known as "The Word" and find your way out of the maze in which you find yourself locked up. Do it before those whose ambition is to control this new apocalyptic world get it.. Do it before they discover a way to reforge the Corona Radiata, the grimoire that will give them ultimate power. And above all, do it before… you are the one to tell them how.

[previewyoutube=LrsZ5RyTaVQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[u][b]Main features:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Single-player, first-person survival horror with a dark, disturbing narrative. 
[*] Gameplay is steeped in psychological horror, stealth, and puzzles. 
[*] Strong narrative content: an original story from the Saga Radiata, the literary universe created by Álvaro Aparicio that includes books, podcasts and other narrative formats, and in which the meta-anthology of horror Dark Atlas is integrated.
[*] The cast of voices in Spanish is led by Alberto "Láudano" Martínez, voice of the popular Spanish podcast Noviembre Nocturno.
[*] A haunting original soundtrack composed to accompany the dark narrative. 
[*] Includes original collectables and Steam Achievements, so you'll want to explore every corner...if you dare.
[/list]

[h3]Dark Atlas: Infernum will be released on PC via Steam, PlayStation and Xbox consoles. Wishlist the game on Steam and [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10009333]PlayStation[/url] now. [/h3]

notes.title: Events attendance
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!
Atlas Negro: Infernum is on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/night-council-studio/atlas-negro-infernum]Kickstarter [/url]and it has a [b]playable demo[/b] here on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2089630/Atlas_Negro_Infernum/]Steam[/url], which is a lot already. But we continue working, because we want to bring this experience personally to all the people we can, so that’s why we’ve also started attending events to showcase our game and get as much feedback and reactions as possible.

On the 15th and 16th of October, we attended [b]VGC Alicante[/b] and showed the demo to a wide audience for the first time. We had a great time, and the feedback we got was very promising. The feelings overall were very good. We were nervous but it was a lot of fun!

A week later, from the 21st to the 23rd of October, we attended [b]#BeeAfraid[/b], a festival focused on horror in all of its forms. We brought our demo for even more people to try it, but that wasn’t all. We also had the chance to discuss about games but also about the universe of Atlas Negro beyond Atlas Negro: Infernum, which was very refreshing. The members of the studio even read some horror stories in a dimly lit room! Finally, we also got to spend some time with Tomás Hijo, the artist of the game’s cover.

At the end of the month, on the 29th and 30th of October we attended [b]IndieDevDay[/b], one of the biggest events for indie games in Spain. It’s a meeting point for all people involved in the national videogame industry, which means we will be meeting a lot of people from other studios and fellow developers, as well as publishers, journalists, influencers… And of course, the players! Atlas Negro: Infernum was [b]showcased to the biggest audience[/b] yet during the course of this event.

That’s all for now, but we hope to continue attending events in the near future, as we are very excited to bring the world of Atlas Negro to everyone!

[b]Did you try the demo and you liked what you saw?[/b]

Then [b]please consider supporting us[/b] on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/night-council-studio/atlas-negro-infernum]Kickstarter [/url]so we can make Atlas Negro: Infernum a better experiencie for all the players.

notes.title: Atlas Negro: Infernum is on Kickstarter!

This is a big challenge, but we’re confident that doing this will allow us to deliver the game we always envisioned, and we’ll ensure every aspect of the game is top notch quality. If you like horror stories and narrative games, this will be for you!

We have prepared lots of exclusive rewards, as well as realistic and meaningful Stretch Goals that we think will bring even more to the table. If you help us spread The Word, we will make sure to deliver the best (and scariest) experience possible to our players!

See you soon!
